name: Project Overview

native.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.project_tasks GROUP BY status

cards.name: Task Quá Hạn Theo Dự Án

native.query: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) as overdue FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.project_tasks t JOIN {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.project_projects p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND t.status NOT IN ('DONE','CANCELLED') GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY overdue DESC
